notes.title: Bonking it up!
notes.content: The Ballad of Bonky is a bouncy arcade adventure! Whack your enemies to shoot 'em bouncing around the room like bullets. Fight cute, evil baddies and epic bosses, solve puzzles and uncover the truth.
